tickets.title: Coordinate charitable transfer
tickets.text: Coordinate a proposed charitable transfer using Nadia Willowdoodle's stated giving intent, eligible assets, tax considerations, custodian requirements, and recipient charity instructions. The planned $18,000 gift to the Moonbadger Literacy Foundation will be evaluated using appreciated Copper Firefly Energy shares held in the Velvet Acorn Custody joint taxable account, with completion targeted before holiday travel. Confirm the recommended transfer method before any forms are sent for signature or assets are moved.

subTasks.title: Confirm gift intent and transfer method
subTasks.text: Document the $18,000 gift intent to the Moonbadger Literacy Foundation, the proposed use of appreciated Copper Firefly Energy shares from the Velvet Acorn Custody joint taxable account, preferred timing before holiday travel, recipient organization details, and whether the transfer is intended as cash, appreciated securities, QCD, donor-advised fund contribution, or another method.

subTasks.title: Review tax and planning considerations
subTasks.text: Check whether the proposed transfer of appreciated Copper Firefly Energy shares aligns with the financial plan, charitable deduction strategy, AGI limits, RMD status if applicable, cost basis considerations, and coordination needs with Nadia Willowdoodle's CPA.

subTasks.title: Prepare transfer instructions and approvals
subTasks.text: Gather Velvet Acorn Custody forms, Moonbadger Literacy Foundation delivery instructions, joint taxable account registration details, signature requirements, and any required compliance approvals before submitting the transfer request.

subTasks.title: Confirm completion and records
subTasks.text: Verify delivery with Velvet Acorn Custody and the Moonbadger Literacy Foundation, save confirmations, note any acknowledgment letter needed, and update the planning record with final transfer details.

tickets.evidence: They agreed by November 15, 2023 to evaluate appreciated shares for Nadia’s planned $18,000 Moonbadger Literacy Foundation gift before holiday travel.

tickets.title: Obtain Cloudberry Kite vesting and withholding details
tickets.text: Obtain the latest restricted stock vesting confirmation or payroll withholding detail from Cloudberry Kite Robotics for Nadia Willowdoodle to estimate 2023 tax exposure from her quarterly restricted stock vesting through 2026.
tickets.evidence: By October 20, 2023, the latest restricted stock vesting confirmation or payroll withholding detail from Cloudberry Kite Robotics is needed to estimate 2023 tax exposure.

tickets.title: Review cash and bonus for allocations
tickets.text: Review cash held above the stated six-month reserve target at Teacup Comet Bank and Nadia Willowdoodle's expected $58,000 December bonus for allocation across 529 college savings for their children ages 12 and 9, additional taxable investment, and mortgage principal comparisons on their $417,000 mortgage fixed at 3.1%.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by December 8, 2023 to review cash above the stated six-month reserve target and the expected bonus for college savings, taxable investment, and mortgage principal comparisons.
